pages.wave1_intro: The Mistspawn rears over the burning square, its Infestation swarming between the houses. Townsfolk scatter behind you. There's nowhere left to fall back to.
pages.wave1_intro_ability_rules:
Omen (Boss and Minions): When a hero is damaged by an enemy with this ability, afterwards, place a monster token on their Delversuit board. Each time they take damage from now on, they take 1 extra damage for each monster token they have for the remainder of the Wave. Clear these monster tokens at the end of the Wave.

Rebirth (Boss and Minions): When the enemy dies, place 3 monster tokens on its tile. After each hero turn where no enemies died, remove 1 monster token from all tiles. Once a tile has its last monster token removed, respawn one of these dead enemies on this tile with 50% health.
pages.assault_end: The last creature falls. For a moment the square is silent but for the crackle of fire.
pages.assault_victory: Bird's Nest still stands. Go to X.1.
pages.assault_defeat: The creatures swarm you. Go to X.2.
